_doc: J2 (VER-002) — the closed roster behind the two-person rule. qa.py's gate_q16() normalises a receipt's 'by' and a capture's 'captured_by' (casefold, collapsed whitespace incl. NBSP, one stripped trailing parenthetical — qa.normalize_person_name()) and then requires BOTH names to resolve against this list, 'by' holding the QA role and 'captured_by' holding the SME role.
_why_a_roster_and_not_just_normalisation: Marcus Reed's VER-002: normalisation alone closes only the ACCIDENTAL bypass (case, padding, doubled/NBSP whitespace, a '(SME)' suffix). It cannot close a DELIBERATE alias — no comparison of free-text names catches someone who chooses to write a different name ('C. Stone'). That half is closed structurally: a name not on this list does not resolve, full stop, regardless of whose alias it might be.
_extend_this_list: New SMEs/QA as intake lands (Milo Vance's task framing, HL-tranche J1-J3). Add a person, then extend their 'roles' — never delete a historical name a shipped receipt still points at, or that receipt's normalise-and-lookup starts failing retroactively.
